tasks.title: Pendant was generating its own runs: disabled DT node armed an ISR on the blue LED pin
tasks.proof: gpio_is_ready_dt() checks the PORT, not the node status; disabled sw1 still resolved to P0.07, which pendant_status.c drives as the blue PWM channel. Mic-muted -> blue breathe -> every PWM edge fired the bookmark ISR -> 34 phantom bookmarks queued, evicting real entries. Drained into the relay as audio-less runs once the SD boot gate was fixed and LTE came up. Fixed with a DT_NODE_HAS_STATUS gate; 34 -> 0, evictions -> 0, backlog drained (pending=0). Orchestrator confirmed on the relay: bursts every ~2.5s stopped, 8+ minutes clean.
